crucialFeats: Bound the Butcher inside his power battery.
Kept fighting after his heart was removed.
Martian Manhunter cannot attack him telepathically.
Burned through the fabric of space with rage plasma.

dossier.advantage: Red ring instead of a heart and inhuman strength. The ring keeps him alive even after fatal wounds, and his physical power allows him to crush energy barriers.
dossier.mentality: A furious zealot driven by revenge. He knows no mercy or hesitation – he pushes forward with a fury that grows more powerful with the enemy's anger.
dossier.quote: I am Atrocitus, lord and master of the Red Lantern Corps. I am wrath, I am hate, I am righteous vengeance!
dossier.style: Brutal, primal aggression. Atrocitus charges opponents to physically tear them apart with his bare hands, supported by corrosive rage plasma.

fighterA.name: Atrocitus

powers: Red Lantern plasma output, constructs, blood magic and rituals, flight, and Butcher-linked rage dynamics.
tools: Emotional-spectrum manipulation and high-pressure ranged offense.
Ability to poison the opponent's Power or energy through contact with blood and plasma.
weaknesses: Prolonged direct brawls can reduce his tactical edge in favor of the opponent's raw strength.

victories: Saint Walker, Indigo-1, and Star Sapphire

crucialFeats: World Breaker scale allows for collateral planet and moon destruction.
Worldbreaker Red She-Hulk and WBH clashing broke the planet.
Nearly sank the entire east coast with a single step.

dossier.advantage: Limitless strength scaling and regeneration. The more injured and angry he gets, the stronger he becomes, making him practically unbeatable in attrition.
dossier.mentality: A stubborn and wild destroyer. He does not calculate or retreat – he pushes forward until all resistance is leveled to the ground.
dossier.style: Unstoppable close-quarters destruction. Relies on pure physical strength and constant forward momentum, crushing everything under his strikes.

fighterB.name: Hulk

powers: Gamma-based strength growth, regeneration, thunderclaps, and extreme stamina.
tools: Gamma radiation emission (in World Breaker mode), destroying everything in the vicinity.
weaknesses: Limited precision utility at long range versus dedicated control users.
Strategy set is narrower when denied sustained contact.

battle-dynamics.phase_1: Atrocitus devours Hulk's rage from the first second. Every roar from the Green Goliath only fuels the Red Ring.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Atrocitus's plasma burns the very fabric of space. Hulk loses his footing, and his biological regeneration has nothing left to recreate.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Conceptual dominance. Atrocitus suppresses Hulk's rage, turning off his 'engine' and erasing him from reality.
battle-dynamics.analysis: In a clash with the host of the Butcher, Hulk is mere infinite fuel. Atrocitus controls every aspect of this annihilation.

fight-simulation.opening: Atrocitus charges, but instead of striking, he begins simply inhaling Hulk's fury.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Hulk erupts with gamma energy, which is immediately consumed and transformed into constructs of red light.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Atrocitus releases plasma that tears a hole in reality, pulling the disoriented opponent into it.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Atrocitus's victory through conceptual erasure of the opponent.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Atrocitus activates Butcher-Sync, turning Hulk's rage into his own fuel.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: The space around the warriors turns into boiling plasma, dissolving matter.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Hulk tries to escape the trap but has no point of support.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Hulk's body begins to decay at an atomic level.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Atrocitus uses Rage Suppression, reverting Hulk to Banner inside the epicenter of the blast.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Bruce Banner is erased from existence.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: The universe is cleansed of the gamma anomaly.

final-summary.line_1: Both warriors feed on rage, but Atrocitus converts it into control, while Hulk converts it into sheer destructive scale.
final-summary.line_2: Atrocitus with the Butcher is an absolute hard-counter for Hulk. The more Hulk fights, the faster he loses.
final-summary.line_3: It is a clash of whether a life-sustaining ring can survive in the heart of an atomic explosion – Atrocitus proves it can.
final-summary.quote: “Rage is fire. Atrocitus is the fire that burns. Hulk is the wildfire that devours the forest... and Atrocitus just drank all the oxygen.”

tactical-board.lane: Atrocitus must keep the fight within the Force's bounds before Hulk turns it into a gamma loop.
tactical-board.subtitle: Butcher versus Worldbreaker

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Conceptual annihilation vs 'Lucky Shot'
verdict-matrix.verdict: Atrocitus 9/10. While World Breaker Hulk is the pinnacle of physical strength, he is a conceptual victim of Atrocitus. The Red Ring not only allows Atrocitus to feed on Hulk's rage but also possesses the rare ability of Rage Suppression. Atrocitus can literally 'turn off' Hulk's fury, reverting him to Bruce Banner with a single impulse of will. Combined with space-burning plasma and the lack of need for oxygen, Atrocitus completely controls the encounter. Hulk retains a 1/10 chance only in the event of an absolute lucky shot – if he managed to destroy the Lantern's ring with one desperate blow before full spectrum control could be activated.

x-factor.implication: Victory depends on whether Atrocitus can close the fight before the opponent's full gamma escalation.
x-factor.mechanics: Hulk grows infinitely. Atrocitus only grows to the ring's energy level, creating a hard power ceiling.
x-factor.psychology: Hulk is pure instinct. Atrocitus is intelligent fury – this difference decides the opening.
x-factor.example: Hulk regenerates an entire arm in a second. Atrocitus doesn't regenerate his body, but his ring replaces damaged organs with energy.
x-factor.question: Is the red rage plasma capable of poisoning gamma radiation, or will it become fuel for it?
